text: Every conversation is a translation, run twice. A thought with no form gets squeezed into words that were never big enough for it,
and the listener runs those words through their own biases until they hold a thought of their own,
“a big cloud of nothingness and everything.”
Has anybody truly begun to understand anybody?
In an effort to be heard, I often forget to hear.
I reach for a story that is relatable to no one but me,
the hints the other person dropped about what they care about
“I hear you and I see you, you are not crazy.”
A man mocked for his accent answers, “I speak English because it’s the only language you know.”
Most of us talk down to the room, and so does everyone else,
The work is to draw people into the language they prefer,
and the way in is to acknowledge their ideas.
How fast a society trades ideas sets how fast it advances,
note: Communication networks as the foundation for proliferation of ideas
